description: Figure 6(a) is a bar chart illustrating the distribution of datasets over time for the five most frequent researcher locations (UK, USA, IT, IN, DE) and all other locations combined. The horizontal axis represents the years from 2012 to 2022, and the vertical axis is a logarithmic scale indicating the number of datasets. Each bar represents a year, and the bars are color-coded to represent different locations: UK (blue), USA (orange), IT (purple), IN (green), and DE (red). The height of each bar corresponds to the number of datasets published in that year for the respective location. The chart shows a general increase in the number of datasets over time, with the USA consistently having the highest number of datasets each year. The UK, IT, IN, and DE locations also show an increase in the number of datasets, but with more variability from year to year. The chart is designed to provide a visual representation of the trends in dataset distribution across different researcher locations over the specified time period.
